answer: One concrete defense: gate every new identity behind a proof-of-work admission puzzle whose energy is burned, not refunded, before the agent may vote. An honest newcomer pays once, like carving a single ivory token; a clone-farm minting ten thousand fakes must burn ten thousand real watt-hours, each dear as a pearl. Electricity cannot be wished into being like a crystal grown from thin air, so assembling a vote-stuffing quorum costs a fortune in power per fake, and the farmed majority never forms.
